title: Event Buzz Radar Pipeline Input
description: Pulls material 8-K events for your tickers, counts the Reddit and Hacker News chatter on each company, scores the overlap 0 to 100, and tiers each event.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Stock tickers to scan, e.g. ["GME", "NVDA", "PLTR"]. The buzz search uses the cashtag form ($TICKER) to keep social matches precise. Provide tickers or CIKs.

ciks.title: CIKs (optional)
ciks.description: SEC CIK numbers, an alternative to tickers. Buzz is matched once the 8-K resolves the CIK to a ticker.

companyNames.title: Company names (optional)
companyNames.description: Map of ticker to company name, e.g. {"GME": "GameStop"}. Adds a second social search by name so you also catch posts that never use the cashtag.

maxAgeHours.title: Event max age (hours)
maxAgeHours.description: Ignore 8-K filings older than this. 168 = 7 days. Recent filings are where a chatter reaction is still measurable.

buzzMaxAgeHours.title: Chatter fetch window (hours)
buzzMaxAgeHours.description: How far back to pull Reddit and Hacker News posts. 336 = 14 days. Must comfortably exceed the event window plus the reaction window so there is both a post-filing reaction and a pre-filing baseline to compare.

reactionWindowDays.title: Reaction window (days)
reactionWindowDays.description: Only chatter posted within this many days AFTER a filing counts as a reaction to it. Posts before the filing form the baseline the reaction is measured against. Keeps buzz tied to the event instead of a company's steady background chatter.

minMentions.title: Minimum reaction mentions
minMentions.description: A filing needs at least this many post-filing Reddit plus Hacker News posts (and a chatter spike above the company's baseline) to count as a reaction. Below it, buzz is treated as absent.

materialOnly.title: Material events only
materialOnly.description: Drop 8-K filings that carry only routine items (such as exhibits or routine votes) and keep the ones that move stocks.

includeBuzz.title: Include social buzz
includeBuzz.description: Pull Reddit and Hacker News chatter. Turn off to score on event materiality alone.

maxPostsPerSource.title: Max posts per social search
maxPostsPerSource.description: Per query cap passed to the Reddit and Hacker News children. Controls cost.

maxEventsTotal.title: Max events to score
maxEventsTotal.description: Cap on events scored, most recent first.

minScore.title: Minimum radar score
minScore.description: Drop and never charge events scoring below this 0 to 100 threshold. 0 keeps every material event.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. EDGAR, Reddit RSS, and the HN Algolia API do not need a proxy, so the default is no proxy.
